audience: developers whose AI agents pay for APIs and datasets in USDC

useCases.title: Check the budget and limits before paying
useCases.text: Read the remaining daily allowance, and the networks, assets and limits the endpoint accepts.

useCases.title: Review recent payments
useCases.text: List the recent payments of the endpoint, then read the state and transaction proof of one payment.

useCases.title: List the payment sources
useCases.text: List the masked payment sources and see whether each one settles without a person.

useCases.title: Pay for a paywalled API or dataset
useCases.text: Create a payment for an agent task. Confirmed means USDC moved on-chain; awaiting approval means a person must act.

useCases.title: Cancel a payment waiting for approval
useCases.text: List the recent payments, then cancel one that still waits for approval, while Veyra allows it.
